text:
maya: hey team — trying to run the JS SDK in a Vercel Edge function and getting "Cannot use import statement outside a module" at runtime. works fine in node.

maya: repro is just `import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-sdk'` inside edge. bundler is esbuild via Next.

maya: current package.json has dual builds: 
```json
{
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
    }
  }
}
```

maya: Edge seems to pick the cjs path then crash. any suggestions?

tony: quick check — we don't have "type":"module" right? dual-package usually leaves type unset. some bundlers ignore module field and resolve exports->require fallback.

maya: correct, no "type" set.

sarah: also remember some toolchains (older rollup/esbuild setups) will prefer the cjs fallback when files have .js extension even if export map points to .mjs.

ryan: two incremental fixes: (1) add an "edge" exports condition pointing to a small ESM edge build, (2) expose a "types" condition to avoid TS resolving to the wrong declaration. example: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```

ryan: bundlers that support the edge condition can pick the tiny runtime. others fall back.

tony: agree. Also consider splitting environment-specific logic (auth/retry) behind an adapter interface. had a case where retry pulled in node fetch polyfills and blew up edge bundle size.

sarah: we did that in the auth refactor: thin core client + adapter per env. node adapter uses undici and the node retry strategy, edge adapter uses native fetch + lightweight retries. keeps parity but avoids bundling node shims.

maya: that sounds like the right long-term approach. short-term, can we publish a tiny shim package like `@redwood/sdk-edge` to unblock users?

tony: pragmatic but messy for docs. alternative: change exports default to import/esm and keep main=cjs. most modern bundlers prefer exports/import mapping. may break require-only users though.

devex-bot: note: if you change exports add a migration note and update the SDK breaking-changes.md.

maya: plan: open PR with 1) an edge-target ESM build and conditional export 2) add a types export condition 3) add examples/next-edge minimal sample that imports the package exactly as users will. will run CI matrix including an esbuild-only smoke test so we catch rewrites.

ci-bot: CI update required: add job to bundle examples/next-edge with Vercel Next build target and run the resulting function in a Node/Edge VM to validate runtime. also add dtslint check against the dist types.

sarah: I'll review the adapter split PR when it's up. recommend adding an integration test that runs the sample app in the local edge emulator. catches fetch/headers differences.

maya: thanks all — opening PR now and will link the example in the description. ping me for quick reviews. :thumbsup:
